Different take on traditional pizza
Oct 2026 • Couples
My wife have visited this restaurant several times. The food and staff have been consistently good each time. They offer a different style of pizza instead of the traditional round pizza, it is a thick rectangular dough with a choice of many toppings. It is similar to Chicago style deep dish pizza. The many side dishes are very good, especially the corn and chicken wings.
We'll come back for sure.

Lots of Choices to Share with Friends and Family
Jan 2026 • Family
Easy to find! There’s a huge pizza sign. 
I love variety and there’s so many fun choices of pizza. You could travel the world without leaving the restaurant. The creativity and execution go hand in hand because I enjoyed the taste of everything we ordered. My family came in a group of 8 and they accommodated our large party.

Must Try Pizza:
- Bulgogi (Korean-inspired) was sweet and savory with delicious kimchi and soft marinade meat
- Chorizo (Mexican-inspired) had a perfect kick of spiciness juiciness and I couldn’t have enough of the crema

Appetizers:
- Chicken Cutlet btoss on top, my Italian in-laws would approve
- Calamari was deep fried with thick crispy breading 

Other Entrees:
- Steak Fajitas came on a sizzling plate with charred vegetables and a hot oil to enjoy on the side
- California Burrito had cheese and fries in it, surprisingly came crispy still with all the filling
- Chicken Quesadilla is a classic dish but came flavorful which we would definitely come back for
- Carbonara Pasta was cheesy and classic
